nodes.name: housekeeping.rs
nodes.summary: Housekeeping E2E scenarios (`--group housekeeping`). Exercises the deferred disk-cleanup pass (`infrastructure::housekeeping::run_deferred_cleanup`) without waiting for the 10-minute startup delay. Relies on three debug-only test endpoints: - `POST /agent/test/housekeeping/run`              — run the cleanup pass synchronously - `POST /agent/test/housekeeping/seed-snapshots`   — plant N synthet...

nodes.name: seed_snapshots
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that seeds snapshots, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: seed_aged
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that seeds aged, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: snapshot_count
nodes.summary: Internal helper function providing `snapshot count` support for the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: run_housekeeping
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that runs housekeeping, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: seed_aged_file
nodes.summary: Seed a flat TTL file under a supported `~/.orgii/` root through the debug-only housekeeping endpoint and return its absolute path.

nodes.name: cap_sweep
nodes.summary: Seed 105 synthetic manifests for a dedicated session, run the deferred cleanup pass, and assert that exactly the 5 excess rows were capped while the remaining 100 survive (positive + negative assertion).

nodes.name: ttl_prune
nodes.summary: Seed an aged session directory (60 days old), seed a fresh session directory alongside it, run the cleanup pass, and assert that only the aged one was removed while the fresh one survives.

nodes.name: happy_noop
nodes.summary: Run the cleanup pass against an empty/steady-state filesystem and assert that no errors surface and all counters stay at zero. Acts as a smoke test that the orchestrator + wiring is sound even when there's nothing to prune.

nodes.name: seed_session_dir
nodes.summary: Internal helper function that seeds session dir, used by the scenario probes in this file.

nodes.name: cursor_config_orphan_evict
nodes.summary: Seed one orphan `cursor-config/<sid>/` (no matching `agent_sessions` row) AND one live `cursor-config/<sid>/` (row inserted), run cleanup, assert orphan gone, live survives. Positive+negative assertions for the orphan sweep path.

nodes.name: screenshots_ttl
nodes.summary: E2E scenario probe verifying screenshots ttl against the running Tauri app's debug test endpoints.

nodes.name: seed_plan_file
nodes.summary: Seed a file under `~/.orgii/plans/<agent_subdir>/<name>` via the `housekeeping/seed-plan-file` debug endpoint. `age_days > 30` makes it eligible for eviction under `PLANS_TTL_DAYS=30`.

nodes.name: merkle_ttl
nodes.summary: Seed one aged merkle snapshot (31 days > `MERKLE_TTL_DAYS=30`) AND one fresh snapshot, run cleanup, and assert Rule 9 positive + negative.

nodes.name: seed_session_cache
nodes.summary: Seed a `sessions` cache row with controlled `cached_at` age (days). `age_days > 30` makes it eligible for eviction under `SESSION_CACHE_TTL_DAYS=30`.

nodes.name: session_cache_exists
nodes.summary: Ask the debug endpoint whether a `sessions` cache row exists for `session_id`. Used by the session-cache TTL scenario.

nodes.name: seed_gateway_binding
nodes.summary: Seed a `gateway_bindings` row. When `insert_session_row=false`, the target `agent_sessions` row is missing, so the sweep sees the binding as orphan. When true, the binding is live (negative branch).

nodes.name: gateway_binding_exists
nodes.summary: Ask the debug endpoint whether a `gateway_bindings` row exists for `session_key`. Used by the gateway-bindings orphan scenario.

nodes.name: seed_session_image
nodes.summary: Seed a `session-images/<name>` file. When `reference_in_message` is true, an `agent_messages.images` row is also inserted pointing at this file so the orphan sweep treats it as live (negative branch).

nodes.name: seed_worktree_dir
nodes.summary: Seed an `agent-worktrees/<repo_hash>/<session_id>/` subdir via the `housekeeping/seed-worktree-dir` debug endpoint. When `insert_session_row` is true the seed also writes an `agent_sessions` row so the orphan sweep treats it as live (negative branch).

nodes.name: plans_ttl
nodes.summary: Seed an aged plan file (31d > `PLANS_TTL_DAYS=30`) inside its own agent_subdir AND a fresh plan file in a separate subdir, run cleanup, and assert Rule 9 positive + negative. Each subdir is unique per run so the empty-dir cleanup of `prune_old_files_recursive` is also exercised (the aged subdir should be gone after cleanup).

nodes.name: agent_worktrees_orphan_evict
nodes.summary: Seed one orphan worktree (no matching `agent_sessions` row) AND one live worktree (with the DB row), run cleanup, and assert Rule 9: orphan is gone, live survives, counter reports >= 1.

nodes.name: session_images_orphan_evict
nodes.summary: Seed one orphan session-image (not referenced by any `agent_messages` row) AND one referenced image, run cleanup, and assert Rule 9 positive + negative.

nodes.name: gateway_bindings_orphan_evict
nodes.summary: Seed one orphan `gateway_bindings` row (pointing at a non-existent `agent_sessions` row) AND one live binding (target exists), run cleanup, and assert Rule 9: orphan is gone, live survives, counter reports >= 1.

nodes.name: session_cache_ttl
nodes.summary: Seed one aged `sessions` cache row (31d > `SESSION_CACHE_TTL_DAYS=30`) AND one fresh row, run cleanup, and assert Rule 9: aged is evicted, fresh survives, counter reports >= 1.

nodes.name: learning.rs
nodes.summary: Learning system E2E scenarios (`--group learning`). Tests the L3 learnings pipeline through HTTP endpoints: reflection, list, deprecate, and prompt injection. Per-agent enable/disable lives in agent-config — not tested here.

nodes.name: deprecate_learning

nodes.name: reflection_pipeline
nodes.summary: Send a conversation then trigger reflection, expecting insights to be extracted.

nodes.name: list_and_deprecate
nodes.summary: List learnings, and if any exist, deprecate one.

nodes.name: learning_prompt_injection
nodes.summary: Full learning round trip: create session → enable learning → chat → reflect → verify learnings injected in prompt.

nodes.name: filtered_list
nodes.summary: Exercise `learnings_list` filters end-to-end: seed two distinguishable rows (one pending, one deprecated), then confirm each filter really narrows the returned set. Also verifies that a guaranteed-missing search term returns an empty list.

nodes.name: status_lifecycle
nodes.summary: Exercise the status lifecycle: pick any existing learning (if present), transition it through pending→active→deprecated→active, then delete it. Skips mutation if no learnings exist but still asserts the API responds.

nodes.name: status_report
nodes.summary: Exercise the consolidation-status endpoint (counts + last-run summary).

nodes.name: delete_protection
nodes.summary: Exercise the delete endpoint: bogus id rejects cleanly AND a seeded `merged` row rejects (lineage protection from `learnings_delete`).

nodes.name: gate_enforced
nodes.summary: Per-agent learnings gate: flip `learnings_enabled=false` via agent-config and confirm (a) the flag round-trips through the JSON file and (b) any reflection trigger that reaches the gate returns a "disabled" error with zero learnings stored. The scenario always restores the flag to `true`.

Pre-fix, `search_similar` / `recall_mode_manifest` called `load_active_learnings` which returned both `active` AND `pending` rows, so new pending rows would "see" each other and get consolidated into merged/none decisions — never promoting to `active`. nodes.name: reflection_transcript_excludes_tool_frames

Seed a session with one of each role (including `tool_call` and `tool_result` whose content carries a distinctive sentinel) and assert: - user text present - assistant text present - tool_call sentinel absent - tool_result sentinel absent If tool content ever leaks back into the transcript (direct SQL change, ...

nodes.name: reflection_blacklist_skips_second_call
nodes.summary: Blacklist-persistence pin — a previously failed `(account, model)` pair persists in the blacklist and subsequent `check` calls short-circuit. Also verifies selectivity: a different `model_id` is NOT blacklisted.
